name: Ronzone (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of maroon, white and maroon, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Ronzone (a letter R, a fir tree and a building) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Ronzone, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Ronzone arms — letter R, a fir tree and a building, crowned, within branches
